text.hi: किताब के पेज 71 पर कविता ‘The Modern Way’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ke page 71 par kavita ‘The Modern Way’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the poem ‘The Modern Way’ on page 71 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: Whom does the poet invite?
steps.modelAnswer: The poet invites her friend for a ride in her rocket.

modelMeaning.hi: कवयित्री अपने दोस्त को अपने रॉकेट की सैर पर बुलाती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kavayitri apne dost ko apne rocket ki sair par bulaati hai.

steps.question: What does she want to see?
options: the moon, and Mars if there is time
steps.answer: the moon, and Mars if there is time
steps.modelAnswer: She wants to see the moon. If there is time, she wants to visit Mars too.

modelMeaning.hi: वह चाँद देखना चाहती है। समय हो तो मंगल पर भी जाना चाहती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh chaand dekhna chahti hai. Samay ho to mangal par bhi jaana chahti hai.

steps.question: Which are the things that attract her?

questionMeaning.hi: कौन सी चीज़ें उसे अच्छी लगती हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kaun si cheezein use achhi lagti hain?

options: the moon, Mars and the stars that shine like diamonds
steps.answer: the moon, Mars and the stars that shine like diamonds
steps.modelAnswer: The moon, Mars and the stars that shine like diamonds in the sky attract her.

modelMeaning.hi: चाँद, मंगल और आसमान में हीरों जैसे चमकते तारे उसे अच्छे लगते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chaand, mangal aur aasmaan mein heeron jaise chamakte taare use achhe lagte hain.

steps.question: Which test has she cleared?

questionMeaning.hi: उसने कौन सा टेस्ट पास किया है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Usne kaun sa test paas kiya hai?

options: the test to fly a rocket
steps.answer: the test to fly a rocket
steps.modelAnswer: She has passed the test to fly her rocket, with perfect ease.

modelMeaning.hi: उसने रॉकेट उड़ाने का टेस्ट बड़ी आसानी से पास किया है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Usne rocket udaane ka test badi aasaani se paas kiya hai.

steps.question: What does she long to do?

questionMeaning.hi: वह क्या करने के लिए तरस रही है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh kya karne ke liye taras rahi hai?

options: to take her friend for a ride in her rocket
steps.answer: to take her friend for a ride in her rocket
steps.modelAnswer: She longs to take her friend for a ride in her rocket.

modelMeaning.hi: वह अपने दोस्त को रॉकेट की सैर कराने के लिए तरस रही है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh apne dost ko rocket ki sair karaane ke liye taras rahi hai.
